summary: My moon slipped in silhouettes of time dancing for new horizons Negligee of night dawns the day's déshabillé embers cast watercolors painting today's portrait in fleeting moments of truth splayed naked #poemsofpresence #smallpoems #flowermoon
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
My moon
slipped
in
silhouettes of time
dancing for new horizons

Negligee of night
dawns the
day's déshabillé
embers cast
watercolors painting
today's portrait
in fleeting moments
of truth splayed
naked
